title: Grid-Based Multi Object Tracker
source_docs: Sensor Fusion and Tracking Toolbox/Multi-Object Tracking Algorithms/Grid_Based_Multi_Object_Tracker.md
text: Grid-based multi-object tracker using random finite set approach, 4 inputs, 3 outputs, {Motion model for tracking} sets Motion model for tracking; {Tracker identifier} sets the unique tracker identifier, {Maximum number of tracks}, {Maximum number of sensors}, {Sensor configurations} sets the configurations of tracking sensors struct, {Update sensor configurations with time}, {Track state parameters} sets the parameters of track state reference frame, {Update track state parameters with time}, {Enable GPU computation}, {X-dimension of grid}, {Y-dimension of grid}, {Resolution of grid}, {Grid origin} sets the origin of grid, {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted, {Minimum and maximum velocity of objects (m/s)} sets the minimum and maximum velocities of objects, {Enable additive process noise}, {Process noise covariance matrix}, {Number of persistent particles}, {Number of new-born particles per step}, {Probability of birth in a cell per step}, {Death rate of targets per unit time}, {Confidence in free space prediction}, {Random number generation} sets the method of random number seed generation, {Initial Seed} sets the initial seed for randomization, {Clustering method for new object extraction}, {Threshold for DBSCAN clustering}, {Minimum number of cells per cluster for DBSCAN}, {Name of ’Custom’ clustering function} sets the name of custom clustering function function, {Function to initialize tracks from grid cell sets}, {Function to update existing tracks}, {Threshold for assigning dynamic grid cells to tracks}, {Confirmation threshold [M N]} sets the threshold for track confirmation, {Deletion threshold [P Q]} sets the threshold for track deletion, {Enable dynamic grid map visualization}, {Plot velocity} enables velocity plotting, {Fast update} enables updating from previous map, {Invert colors} enables inverted colors, {Prediction time source} sets the source of prediction time, {Enable tentative tracks output} enables output port for tentative tracks, {Enable all tracks output} enables output port for all tracks and {Source of output bus name} sets the source of output track bus name. Values come from the instance.
